name: Miller County, AR
findings: Miller County has 110 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (28%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 26 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Miller County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list membership
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list membership. In similar places of this size, about 8 would.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Do people here look for groups to join through social and fraternal groups? Where else does that happen?

observations.title: Religious organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 20 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 20 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do religious organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Few social and fraternal organizations list public events
observations.text: No social and fraternal organizations here list public events. In similar places of this size, about 5 would.

confidence.text: Based on 5 organizations here; 34% of all organizations here have no identified type.
